cards.name: Arkadiy Dobkin
cards.text:
Arkadiy Dobkin

Principal Founder & Executive Chairman, EPAM

Public discussion · Thinking Systems

Arkadiy publicly recommended reading Thinking Systems and contributed two further perspectives to the discussion.

First, model-mediated systems may expand the range of problems that software can address, rather than merely replace existing solutions.

Second, as foundation models and generic agent infrastructure commoditize, domain- and client-specific control architectures may remain a significant source of differentiation.

These perspectives extend the discussion beyond runtime engineering into market opportunities, enterprise capabilities, and long-term competitive advantage.

Read Arkadiy’s original post ↗

rows.paragraph: Auto uses your device's local time: Day from 07:00 until 19:00, Night otherwise. You can choose either theme yourself. Theme and motion preferences are stored locally in your browser; no location request, account or analytics is involved. Scrolling and Writing topic choices leave the camera at the page’s opening view. Main-page navigation retains the camera flight and content fade. The thematic structures also move gently in a repeating cycle while you read. Motion off freezes both the camera and the structures; your reduced-motion preference overrides a saved On choice. Theme changes only recolor that view. No measurement or scientific simulation is represented. Without JavaScript, your device's light/dark preference and a static geometric background supply the fallback.
